answer: The lotus lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ivory is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, published publicly on failure, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. By the walnut of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
